annotations.title: Deploy a built app on OxyPages

description: Deploy an already-BUILT web app (React, Vue, Svelte, Vite, Astro static output, any single-page app) to OxyPages with no account and get a live HTTPS link with Single-Page App routing. OxyPages does NOT build: Run the project's build first (npm run build, or the build script in package.json) and send the OUTPUT folder (usually dist/, build/ or out/), not the source. Never send node_modules, source files or package.json - source is refused with needs_build. Text as utf8, binaries as base64. Up to 25 MB and 500 files. If the output has no index.html, pass root (the HTML file to serve at /) or root "none". The link lasts 30 minutes: give the user url AND claim_url, and tell them to open claim_url to keep the app in a free account.

files.description: Every file of the build OUTPUT folder (dist/, build/ or out/), paths relative to that folder (index.html, assets/index-3f9a1c2b.js).

encoding.description: utf8 for text (the default), base64 for images, fonts and other binaries.

path.description: Path relative to the output folder, e.g. index.html or assets/app.js.

root.description: Only when there is no index.html: the HTML file to serve at /, or "none".

name: deploy_app
